text:
Making sure!
My partner’s original/first B2 tourist visa runs out today as he entered 3 months ago. We’re still getting the necessary documents for a partner visa process so we haven’t started it yet. He’s anxious about getting deported even though we’ve read the PIBA announcements that anyone in his place gets a 3 months automatic extension. He did not leave the country in the past 3 months so he was physically in Israel when both extensions rolled out (but we didn’t get any text or email from PIBA).

So for just validation sake - we are correct at understanding that if his original visa end date is today, he is okay to stay in the country for up to 3 more months on the basis of being with a B2 visa? *British passport (and not Jewish) though I don’t think relevant here.

Thank you!
